submission.justification: Radiator-R2 at 2.0 cm thickness provides the best pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c, achieving 4.624 sigma. This represents the optimal configuration after testing all three radiator candidates across the allowed thickness range (1-6 cm). The high-index porous radiator R2 outperforms R3 (3.914 sigma at 3 cm, lower at other thicknesses) and R1 (2.848 sigma at 3 cm) significantly. The performance curve shows R2 has a peak around 2 cm thickness, with degradation at both thinner and thicker values. The dry nitrogen environment in the vessel should preserve the radiator's performance over the experiment's lifetime, and no specific degradation concerns are documented for R2. The 2.0 cm thickness also provides practical advantages in terms of material cost and minimizing multiple scattering compared to thicker options.
